sentences.text: January is the first month of the year.
March brings the scent of flowers.
May is the last school month.
July invites us to the sea.
November comes with a cold wind.
December is the last month of the year.
Coffee wakes me in the morning.
I want black coffee without sugar.
The coffee was made at the cafe.
Tea calms me in the evening.
The milk is in the fridge.
Hot milk helps the child sleep.
Sugar is kept in a jar.
Rice is cooking in the pot.
White rice is added to the soup.
The soup is hot and tasty.
Chicken soup helps a sick person.
Soup warms me in the evening.
Fresh vegetables are from the market.
Vegetables are cut into the salad.
The banana is sweet and soft.
I have a yellow banana for breakfast.
The banana got crushed in the bag.
I like a sweet orange in winter.
An orange is rich in vitamins.
The apple fell from the tree.
I have an apple with me at school.
The potato cooks in the pot.
Potato is the base of the soup.
The red tomato ripened in the sun.
Chopped onion goes into the soup.
Onion spreads a smell in the house.
The butter froze in the fridge.
Cheese is put in the sandwich.
The salad is full of vegetables.
Green salad is dressed with oil.
I have breakfast together with family.
I have a quick lunch at the office.
Dinner brings us together in the evening.
A light dinner is for health.
The sandwich is filled with cheese.
A quick sandwich feeds me on the way.
The sandwich has bread and butter.
Cucumber is cut into the salad.
A fresh cucumber is like water.
The strawberry is sweet and juicy.
Strawberry is put on the cake.
A yellow lemon is rich in vitamin.
The cake is for the birthday.
The cake is decorated with candles.
The book is open on the table.
I brought an interesting book from the library.
The book starts a new chapter.
A new notebook has clean pages.
I forgot the notebook in the bag.
The pen writes with blue ink.
I put the pen on the notebook.
A short pencil needs a sharpener.
The table is covered with a cloth.
A round table is in the middle of the room.
The chair stands by the table.
The chair is made of wood.
The bed has a soft pillow.
A big bed fits two people.
The bed invites me in the evening.
A heavy door needs a key.
The door closed in the wind.
